starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee.speaker: Aris
starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee.text: Skrach! He'd be un-frozen in a jiffy if he just had some Jubbly.

starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee.player: And once again, but in English this time?

starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee.speaker: Aris
starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee.text: Sorry...Skrach, being an ogre likes Chompies, and a real delicacy is Jubbly Chompy bird. Do you think you could get some?

options.text: Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy.

steps.player: Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy.

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: That's the spirit!

steps.player: Ok then, what's involved...how do I get this Jubbly chompy?

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: Ah, well, that's where it breaks down a bit you see. The only 'thing' alive which might help you get the Jubbly Chompy is the most confusing beast that Gielinor has ever known.

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: The situation is lost I am afraid and I understand totally if you decide not to help Skrach.

steps.player: Oh come on...it can't be that difficult..

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: I'm afraid it is. You see...you need to go and speak to an Ogre called Rantz over in the Feldip hills.

steps.player: Ahh right...I see..

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: How do you feel about getting Jubbly Chompy now and freeing Skrach?

options.text: No way am I going to talk to Rantz.

steps.player: No way am I going to talk to Rantz.

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: I quite understand...

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: I really do...

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: There's no excuse for him really...

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: Poor old Skrach...

options.text: Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.

steps.player: Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: Well, I do pity you, and wish you the best of luck!

options.text: Nah, leave that Ogre in the frozen dimension!

steps.player: Nah, leave that Ogre in the frozen dimension!

steps.speaker: Aris
steps.text: Alas, I can certainly relate to what you say. However, he deserves to be set free, the same as everyone else.

starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee-.player: What should I do now to help Skrach?

starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee-.speaker: Fortuneteller
starting-off-inspecting-skrach-uglogwee-.text: Skrach needs Jubbly chompy in order to be unfrozen, you'll need to talk to Rantz about how to get that. Perhaps the cook can be more helpful.

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember how I defeated him can you?

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

options.text: Protecting the Dwarf
Protecting the Goblins
Protecting the Pirate
Protecting the Lumbridge Guide
Protecting Evil Dave
Protecting the Ogre

steps.player: Just remind me again how I managed to unfreeze Skrach?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Certainly. Everyone knows that Skrach loves Jubbly Chompy, preferably roasted on a spit! The bird's carcass is so big, it can't be cooked any other way.

steps.player: And how do I get one of those?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I wouldn't know much about that, but I believe you talked to Rantz quite a bit over in the Feldip hills. Apparently, he got you to do him quite a few favours before you actually got the Jubbly.

steps.player: Oh yeah... I remember now...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?

options.text: Protecting the Sir Amik Varze
Protecting the Monkey
Defeating the Culinaromancer

ranting-with-rantz-talking-to-rantz.speaker: Rantz
ranting-with-rantz-talking-to-rantz.text: Hey deyr, t'anks for da chompy, it was scrumbly!

options.text: Hey, I wanted to ask about hats...
I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?

steps.player: I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Skrach...he big boss? Skrach like da Jubbly chompy...is bestest yums like chompy.

steps.player: Ok, so can you help me get some Jubbly Chompy?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Rantz tell creature hows to stick da Jubbly...just like da Chompy...

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Soon, creature be da ogre too like Rantz! Harr, har, har!

steps.player: A nice thought, but unlikely...

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: But creature do Rantz stuffsies first...yous creature gets Rantz to other lands over 'der so Rantz gets da stuffsies for da glugs-glugs.
Rantz points to the North East, in the direction of Karamja.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous do dis creature for da Jubbly?

options.text: What's involved?

steps.player: What's involved?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's creature gets Rantz to other lands over 'der so Rantz gets da stuffsies for da glug-glugs.

options.text: What do I get in return?

steps.player: What do I get in return?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Me's shows da creatures how to sneaky, sneaky stick da Jubbly!

options.text: Ok, I'll do it.

steps.player: Ok, I'll do it.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Dat's da good fing, you's creature goes down by da watery place, over near da cabbage! Me's says more der'.
Rantz points to the south east near a largish tree.

steps.player: Ok, will do!

options.text: No way am I doing that!

steps.player: No way am I doing that!

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.

Ok, here I am...I guess this is the watery place? What now?

steps.player: Ok, here I am...I guess this is the watery place? What now?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's creatures says what Rantz need for da going over da big water to da over'der place.
Rantz points to the North East...

steps.player: Oh, so you want to go to Karamja...hmmmm, it's a bit of a long walk. You'd probably be better off with a boat!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Is what me's says...you's creature no helpsies...just says Rantz saysies back!

steps.player: Ohhhh...sorry! Ok, for a boat you'll need something that floats in order to make a hull.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Uh rocksie?

steps.player: Close!... But perhaps a tree would be better?

steps.text: Screen fades to a cutscene.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Me finks me has found one...
Rantz kicks over the old tree.

steps.player: ...very good...

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.
Ask about hats...
Can you tell me how to get Jubbly now?

steps.player: Can you tell me how to get Jubbly now?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's creatures not done for Rantz fingies yet! Da boatsie is da guddun...will carry rantz to da over place?

steps.player: You can't use that as a boat! The roots are still hanging off it.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Ok, you's creature makes it better!

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.

ranting-with-rantz-trimming-the-log-s-ro.text: You trim the roots of the tree back.

options.text: Ask about hats...
Now can you please tell me how to get Jubbly?

steps.player: Now can you please tell me how to get Jubbly?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Creatures not done yet! Da boatsie not good for da stuffsies! Da stuffsies for da glug-glugs goes in da watery stuffs.

steps.player: Well, yes, you've got no space to put anything in there... it needs to be hollowed out a bit.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Ok, you's creature makes it better!

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.

ranting-with-rantz-hollowing-out-the-boa.text: You hollow out a bit of the boat...

options.text: Ask about hats...
Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly?

steps.player: Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous do other stuffsies for Rantz first. We's needs da bestest groundy for da walking on new land.

steps.player: Bestest groundy? New land?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Rantz use stabbie chucker and stick da dirt for da over der' place. You's creature make da chompy by da stabber so Fycie and Bugs sniffs da bestest yumms and splosh over wiv da boatsie!
Rantz prepares to shoot the bow...
Rantz shoots an arrow out to sea.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Ok you's person...goes find da stabber!

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.

Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!

steps.player: Please, can you just show me how to catch a Jubbly!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Creatures not done Rantz stuffsies yet!

steps.player: Ok, what do you need me to do now?

steps.speaker: Rantz

steps.player: Huh?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's creature...goes to da over der' place and cook da chompy by da stabber!
Rantz points over to the north east, in the dim distance you can see a beach near Tai Bwo Wannai.

options.text: Actually, I don't need to talk to you...sorry.

ranting-with-rantz-after-cooking-the-cho.text: You hear a commotion out to sea...
Fycie and Bugs swim to shore with the ogre boat.

ranting-with-rantz-after-cooking-the-cho.speaker: Bugs
ranting-with-rantz-after-cooking-the-cho.text: Hey there...we's could smell da Chompy from ages back...it smells lish!

ranting-with-rantz-after-cooking-the-cho.speaker: Bugs
ranting-with-rantz-after-cooking-the-cho.text: Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want?

ranting-with-rantz-boarding-the-ogre-boa.speaker: Bugs
ranting-with-rantz-boarding-the-ogre-boa.text: Dad says you can get a free lift back with us if you want?

options.text: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.

steps.player: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.

steps.text: You accept a free ride from Fycie and Bugs on the makeshift boat.
You're ogre-propelled to the Feldip Hills!
The barely sea-worthy log arrives at the Feldip Hills.

options.text: No thanks.

steps.player: No thanks.

options.text: Ask about hats...
Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!

steps.player: Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: What's creature's say?

steps.player: I've helped with your scheme to get over to Karamja, now help me by telling me how to get Jubbly!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Ohhh, get's Jubbly...dat's da easy fing...you's creature is a bit stoopid for not know dat!

steps.player: Just tell me!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Okays creature's keeps hairsies on...

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Ok then you's creature...you's use da big blowers on da fatsie toady. Creature makes da fatsie toady and den needs da rocksie an da wooly fing to stick it down da ground.

jubbly-hunt-mining-a-rock.text: You swing your pick at the rock.
You manage to mine a rock.

jubbly-hunt-creating-a-balloon-toad.text: You manage to inflate a bloated toad with the swamp gas.
You blow the bloated toad up into a balloon toad.

jubbly-hunt-placing-the-balloon-toad.text: You carefully place the balloon toad bait.

jubbly-hunt-killing-a-jubbly.text: You scratch a notch on your bow for the jubbly bird kill.

jubbly-hunt-plucking-a-jubbly.text: You start plucking the Jubbly bird.

jubbly-hunt-attempting-to-use-an-iron-sp.player: I saw some large static ogre spits near Jiggig and Rantz. Perhaps I can cook this jubbly meat there?

jubbly-hunt-cooking-a-jubbly.text: You carefully place the Jubbly on the spit-roast.
You start to cook the Jubbly...it takes some time.
Eventually the Jubbly is nicely cooked.

jubbly-hunt-freeing-skrach-uglogwee.speaker: Aris
jubbly-hunt-freeing-skrach-uglogwee.text: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [number] council members left to protect!
